name: Carrier-Typed Matrix-Element Terminality
statement: An adequacy residual on a typed carrier reaches matrix-element terminality when named operator-algebra reductions convert residual closure into a specific family of carrier-native matrix elements, while inherited records do not decide those elements and do not make their decision logically equivalent to the target conclusion.
instantiation: Branch C terminal family L_{rho,k}(G)=<M_zeta G,P_infty y_{rho,k}>.
reason_for_candidate: The pattern is generalizable across typed carriers because the terminal object is a carrier-native matrix element rather than an informal missing proof.
